bugs.error_message: Tool result is missing for tool call ... when user sends a chat message while a tool approval is pending.
bugs.root_cause: New user messages could be submitted before unresolved AI SDK tool approval requests had a denial/approval result, leaving the conversation with an assistant tool call but no tool result.
bugs.fix: Track active pending approval IDs from AgentRunBridge and deny them before sending new messages from the composer or store send helper.

bugs.error_message: opencode scrolling feels poor inside the terminal.
bugs.root_cause: The xterm renderer used default wheel scroll sensitivity and instant scroll behavior, which can feel jumpy in TUI apps and terminal scrollback.
bugs.fix: Set explicit xterm scrollSensitivity, fastScrollSensitivity, and smoothScrollDuration defaults in the terminal renderer pool.

bugs.error_message: macOS Dock right-click/show-window action does not reveal Terax windows reliably.
bugs.root_cause: The app did not handle macOS NSApplication reopen events from the Dock, so minimized/hidden windows were not explicitly shown and focused.
bugs.fix: Handle tauri::RunEvent::Reopen on macOS and show, unminimize, and focus the main window, falling back to spawning a new Terax process if the main window is gone.

bugs.error_message: Codex auth token expires after ~1h causing silent 401 failures mid-session
bugs.root_cause: The LanguageModel was cached with the access token baked into apiKey at build time. After OAuth refresh the cached model still sent the old expired token.
bugs.fix: Removed model caching for codex provider. The codexFetch interceptor now calls codex_get_access_token on every request and overwrites the Authorization header with the fresh token.

bugs.error_message: <env> context blocks accumulated across turns, bloating the context window with stale snapshots
bugs.root_cause: injectEnvIntoLastUser prepended a new <env> block each turn but never stripped old ones from earlier messages in history.
bugs.fix: Added ENV_BLOCK_RE + stripEnvBlock. injectEnvIntoLastUser now strips <env> from ALL user messages before injecting the fresh block only into the last user message.

bugs.error_message: originator header sent as 'originator' but Codex endpoint expects 'openai-originator'
bugs.root_cause: agent.ts used originator: 'terax' while the integration test and PR fork both use openai-originator.
bugs.fix: Renamed header to openai-originator in agent.ts buildLanguageModel codex branch.
